item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning no. Xi’s 2024 record contains real equality-oriented policy moves for women, disabled people, migrants, rural students, and low-income workers, but the broader system still used repression, censorship, and minority control in ways that undercut dignity and equal opportunity.

**Supports Yes**

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level note | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Central transfers were raised to support equal basic public services, with large budget lines for education, social insurance, employment, and public health | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-03-14 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/14/content_WS65f2f558c6d0868f4e8e5166.html | The budget emphasized equalization of basic public services rather than just aggregate GDP, which is direct evidence of broader opportunity and dignity framing. | 6B.8, 6B.2, 6B.5 |
| Campaign to implement the revised women’s-rights law and address rights violations affecting women | Supreme People’s Procuratorate | 2024-03-28 | https://en.spp.gov.cn/2024-03/28/c_976798.htm | Beijing publicly treated women’s-rights enforcement as a rights issue, not only a welfare issue. That is relevant positive evidence for dignity and equal treatment. | 6B.8, 6B.3 |
| China to build pilot zones for special needs education reform | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-04-09 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202404/09/content_WS661549dec6d0868f4e8e5e47.html | The plan promised free basic education for students with disabilities plus better staffing and pay, which directly targets equal opportunity for a vulnerable group. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.4 |
| The state used central and local salary support to send trained teachers to rural, especially disadvantaged, regions and prioritized shortage subjects | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-05-13 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/13/content_WS664215abc6d0868f4e8e7105.html | This is targeted opportunity-building, not just aggregate social spending. It narrows rural/urban gaps in educational access. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.4 |
| The ministry reported premium assistance for low-income residents, people returning to poverty, and severely disabled individuals | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-05-03 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/03/content_WS6634e761c6d0868f4e8e6b13.html | The policy explicitly names disadvantaged groups, including the disabled, and treats coverage as a protection issue rather than a loyalty issue. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.2 |
| China issues guidelines to promote high-quality and sufficient employment | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-09-25 | https://english.www.gov.cn/policies/latestreleases/202409/25/content_WS66f41813c6d0868f4e8eb446.html | The guidelines call for targeted employment support for key groups and expanded social insurance, indicating an inclusionary approach to opportunity. | 6B.8, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| China issues guideline to promote employment for migrant workers | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-11-22 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202411/22/content_WS674082c7c6d0868f4e8ed552.html | The policy pushes broader job channels, wage-rights protection, social insurance, public services, and further hukou relaxation. That is directly about equal opportunity, not only welfare volume. | 6B.8, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| China to launch trial operations of service-oriented social assistance | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-08-14 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202408/14/content_WS66bcb5dfc6d0868f4e8e9e9f.html | Social assistance was expanded into care and nursing services for financially challenged people, which is a dignity-oriented shift rather than only cash transfer logic. | 6B.8, 6B.2, 6B.3 |
| Local work-relief programs created 2.45 million jobs for low-income workers and paid 31 billion yuan in wages | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-11-04 | https://english.www.gov.cn/archive/statistics/202411/04/content_WS672879d6c6d0868f4e8ec91e.html | This is concrete support for economically marginalized workers and indicates some effort to preserve equal access to work and income. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.6 |
| China says the 56 ethnic groups are equal and entitled to participate in state governance | PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs | 2024-05-30 | https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/xw/zwbd/202405/t20240530_11365953.html | This is the regime’s own equality claim. It is weak as proof, but it is direct evidence that Beijing frames minority equality as an official norm. | 6B.8, 6B.3 |

**Supports No**

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level note | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|

That is direct evidence against equal opportunity. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7 |
| Xinjiang’s revised religious rules intensify Sinicization and threaten imprisonment for noncompliance | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-31 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/31/china-religious-regulations-tighten-uyghurs | This is coercive minority control rather than protection of dignity or equal opportunity. It shows the state imposing ideological conformity on a vulnerable group. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7 |
| Li Qiaochu unjustly convicted for speaking out about torture | Amnesty International | 2024-02-05 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/china-activist-li-qiaochu-unjustly-convicted-for-speaking-out-about-torture/ | A women’s-rights and workers’rights advocate was punished after describing abuse. That is strong evidence against a dignity-centered equality regime. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7 |
| China’s “malicious” conviction of #MeToo and labour activists shows Beijing’s growing fear of dissent | Amnesty International | 2024-06-14 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/china-malicious-conviction-of-metoo-and-labour-activists-shows-beijings-growing-fear-of-dissent/ | Beijing used national-security charges against activists tied to women’s dignity and workers’ rights. That undercuts claims of genuine equal opportunity. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7 |
| Hong Kong’s landmark national-security trial for 47 democrats | Reuters | 2024-05-30 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hong-kongs-landmark-national-security-trial-for-47-democrats-3462427 | Mass prosecutions, bail denial, and long sentences show political punishment rather than equal civic dignity. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7 |
| Article 23 broadens sabotage, sedition, and state-secrets offenses and can impose life imprisonment | Reuters | 2024-03-19 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/factboxscope-of-hong-kongs-new-national-security-laws-3344082 | This broadens repression rather than protecting equal opportunity or dignity for dissenting groups. | 6B.8, 6B.7 |
| Radio Free Asia shut its Hong Kong bureau after Article 23 raised safety concerns | Reuters | 2024-03-29 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/usfunded-radio-free-asia-shuts-hong-kong-bureau-citing-security-law-concerns-3358157 | Chilling independent reporting reduces public accountability for unequal treatment and abuse. | 6B.8, 6B.5, 6B.7 |
| The new Hong Kong district council election became a “patriots-only” contest | South China Morning Post | 2024-04-17 | https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3259258/first-hong-kong-district-council-poll-after-electoral-overhaul-cost-taxpayers-hk12-billion | Managed selection replaced competition, which is the opposite of equal political opportunity. | 6B.8, 6B.3, 6B.7 |

**Search Gap**
The positive side is mostly official policy and implementation claims, not independent outcome audits showing lived dignity or equality improved. The negative side is strongest in Hong Kong and Xinjiang, where repression against dissenters and minorities is better documented than any nationwide equal-opportunity guarantee.
